audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagree with both the packet and their own reasons. win[0]/phases[0].side say 'Skill' while whys[0] opens 'Level 1 is hers'; rows 1, 2 and 5 say 'Irelia' while whys[1], whys[2] and whys[5] each end with the word 'even'. The packet levelChart and the already-applied mirror audit both read Fiora / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Irelia.
audit.why: Fiora owns level 1 outright — she Lunges in for a Vital and dashes out against an Irelia with no stun. From 2 onward it is a parry mind-game rather than a stage either champion owns, until Irelia's two-item sustained trade.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2 and 5 flipped in both layers as one group, with the level-1 rating dropped to 3/10.
sources: brief currentText whys[0], whys[1], whys[2], whys[5]

audit.whatIsWrong: Riposte is named the matchup-defining cooldown in eight places and its number appears nowhere, so 'bait Riposte' has no timing attached.
audit.why: Riposte is 24/22/20/18/16s — a 24-second rank-1 cooldown is the longest window in the lane and the entire reason the bait is worth setting up. Flawless Duet's own 16s at rank 1 is the other half of that trade maths. Grand Challenge is 110/90/70s.
audit.corrected: The 24s figure written into dosFull[0].d, dosFull[1].d, phases[2].why and breakdown.cooldowns; Flawless Duet's 16s into dontsFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. (a) wants.you[1] and the mid paragraph tell the player to eat her vital-proc burst with Defiant Dance. Vitals are true damage and Defiant Dance reduces PHYSICAL damage only, so that mitigation does not exist — while the mitigation that does exist, against her Bladework crit and her autos, is never mentioned. (b) Irelia's passive is described as 'armor/MR shred' in whys[6], spikes[3].text, late and wants.foe[2]; Ionian Fervor is stacking attack speed plus bonus on-hit damage at max stacks and shreds nothing. The heal in her kit is on Bladesurge.
audit.why: Riot's text: Irelia W 'takes reduced physical damage during the charge'; Irelia P stacking Attack Speed and bonus damage on hit; Irelia Q 'healing herself'. Fiora R carries the trueDamage flag, and Riposte 'parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time... or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect' — which is why a parried Flawless Duet stuns Irelia rather than Fiora.
audit.corrected: wants.you[1] repointed at Bladework and autos; whys[6] and spikes[3].text rewritten off the shred claim; the parry-stun reversal stated with numbers in dontsFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] justifies early Executioner's Calling with 'his healing fights your pattern' — wrong pronoun, no named source.
audit.why: The healing is Duelist's Dance on every Vital hit plus Grand Challenge's area heal on a completed set or a kill.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to name Vitals and her ultimate; the Vital heal also written into dontsFull[1].d.

edits.before: Stack passive on the wave before any trade. Identify how Fiora contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Hers — she Lunges in for a Vital and dashes out while you have Bladesurge and no stun to pin her. Just farm.

edits.before: Q resets through minions are your engine — keep the wave healthy. Only take the trade when Fiora's Riposte is down.
edits.after: Even: Defiant Dance blunts her Bladework autos, but she still Lunges in and out free and neither of you commits.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Fiora must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Flawless Duet arrives, but Riposte (24s at rank 1) parries the cast and stuns you — a coin-flip on the parry read.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Riposte's cooldown.
edits.after: Even: your first-item reset spike is real, but her Vital true damage and a held parry match it.

edits.before: Charge 4 passive stacks on minions, E-stun Fiora when his answer is down, and Q-reset through the wave onto the kill.
edits.after: Charge 4 Ionian Fervor stacks on minions, Flawless Duet her once Riposte is spent, then Bladesurge through the wave.

edits.before: - Fiora Riposte: matchup-defining — Parries your E-stun. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Fiora Riposte (24s at rank 1): matchup-defining — parries all damage, and blocking your stun stuns YOU. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: kill windows.

edits.before: Parries your E-stun. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Charge 4 passive stacks on minions, E-stun Fiora when his answer is down, and Q-reset through the wave onto the kill.

edits.before: Fiora wastes Riposte — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Pinned, she cannot Lunge to a Vital or reposition off it.

edits.after: Max Ionian Fervor gives stacking attack speed and bonus on-hit damage, and Bladesurge heals you each reset — but her Vitals are true damage, so the duel stays a coin-flip on the parry read.
